recent_items.summary: World action models (WAMs) for autonomous driving couple the driving policy and the visual world model in a single generative network whose objectives are fixed post-training. Conditioning on a new driving objective requires retraining. recent_items.title: GuidedWAM: Training-Free Energy Guidance for World Action Models in Autonomous Driving
